standard.summary: 线性外推用的历史窗口。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: The history window used for linear extrapolation.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 线性外推用的历史窗口。窗口越大跳过越多、越快，但 latent 漂移越大。默认 3。

advanced_en.principle: History window for linear extrapolation. A bigger window skips more and runs faster, but latent drift grows. Default 3.
